environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB is internet-facing with a default listener rule forwarding all traffic on port 443 to the target group. Security group sg-0a4f8e2c allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. The service handles template rendering for the marketing email pipeline.
